Zoe: FYI I hit a dashboard crash in staging when a subset of routes have unsampled traces. The 'cost by route' panel returns a 500. Quick glance shows the example query in docs groups on `span_id`.
Paul: that's expected when sampling=false for many requests. Panels that group by span_id often fail if the label is absent. can you paste the query?
Zoe: pasted (from docs):
```promql
sum(cost_total) by (route, span_id)
```
Maya: yep, change to coalesce and normalize label names. Suggest: `sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, \"unknown\"), coalesce(span_id, \"unsampled\"))`. Put it in the migration guide and add a one-line regression check.
Zoe: good. also found the tracing quickstart link in the observability TOC still references `/tracing-hook.md`. that file was reorganized last quarter.
Paul: should point at `/observability/tracing-hooks/overview` now. infra, can you add a redirect rule?
infra: filing INF-292 for redirect and sidebar update. ETA tomorrow morning.
Zoe: thanks 44d. Also add tiny SDK snippets for Go and Rust in the docs so platform teams have examples for tagging requests (we have examples for node/python already). Keep them one-liners.
Maya: Go snippet suggestion:
```go
// attach route metadata for dashboards
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, \"\", GenerateOptions{Metadata: map[string]string{\"route_name\":\"checkout_v3\"}})
```
Maya: Rust example (pseudo):
```rust
// add route metadata
let resp = client.generate(\"\", Some(GenerateOptions{metadata: hashmap!{\"route_name\" => \"checkout_v3\"}})).await?;
```
Paul: looks good. Add a short note: \"Dashboards should not assume every request has a span_id; use coalesce to provide a fallback label.\"
Zoe: adding a curl regression test too: `curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.internal/query -d '{"query":"sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, \"unknown\"), coalesce(span_id, \"unsampled\"))"}' | jq`
Maya: also call out quantized-model unit reconciliation: some endpoints emit token timing in ms. recommend using `coalesce(rate(token_duration_seconds[5m]), rate(token_duration_ms[5m]) / 1000)` in examples.
Zoe: will include wording: \"When using quantized model variants, reconcile token duration units to avoid NaNs in p95 panels.\"

Paul: assigning reviewers: @maya @zoe. tiny nit: use consistent key `route_name` across snippets.
Maya: LGTM. left one editorial nit about phrasing.
Paul: approved. :white_check_mark:
Zoe: merged. INF-292 created for redirects. closing thread, thanks!
